title: GuideHollow production-browser QA: reproducible exercises and limits
scope: Actual public GuideHollow website interacted with by a browser agent. Underlying sample sales, garden, release and event data are invented. No Excel, Google Sheets, ChatGPT or external AI model was executed.
method: Live browser UI interaction and reading rendered results; not only source-code inspection. Separate Node regression tests are published in the repository.

trials.limits: Data are fictional and amounts have no verified currency.
The new calculated weighted average is a display rounded to two decimals.

observed.error: Row 8: UnitPrice must be a nonnegative number; blanks are not zero.
observed.summary: No result: correct the input and try again.

trials.limits: Demonstrates local input validation, not accounting compliance.

observed.g04Reason: The meeting location is not confirmed.

trials.limits: The first browser run did not preserve verified pre-submit radio states; the cause of its 1/5 score is unknown. A later post-fix live-browser run independently verified that all five intended values were selected and correctly scored 4/5. The historical cause cannot be inferred retrospectively.

trials.input: Post-fix five-case practice: select only G04=SUPPORTED; leave four other questions unanswered; press Check my source-reading answers once.

observed.selectionStatus: 1 of 5 claims answered. Read the source and select one verdict for each claim before grading.
observed.submitStatus: Only 1 of 5 claims answered. Select a verdict for every claim before grading.

trials.limits: Narrow post-fix UI smoke test of an incomplete five-case submission. A separate, later complete five-case live-browser test independently verified 4/5 with all choices inspected before grading. Neither test establishes cross-browser or AI model accuracy.

trials.input: Live five-case practice in production; intentionally set G04 to the wrong verdict, the other four to their published reference verdicts. All five selected radio states were visually inspected before grading.

observed.preSubmitStatus: 5 of 5 claims answered. All choices are selected; you can now check your answers.
observed.g04Reason: The meeting location is not confirmed.
observed.afterSubmitStatus: 4/5 labels matched the published teaching key. Review the explanation for every mismatch.

trials.limits: Verified only the five-question scoring path on the live GuideHollow site via a browser agent. The underlying garden/release/event data and editorial reference key are fictional. This neither identifies the cause of an earlier 1/5 run nor tests real AI model performance, all 22 questions, or all browser environments.

trials.input: Load the public fictional garden example, build a prompt, edit output 'under 70 words' to 'under 50 words', click Copy, change the original audience to 'Garden volunteers', rebuild, and reset.

copy.feedback: Your current edited draft was copied.

inputChange.status: Inputs changed. Your previous draft is kept below, but it is now out of date. Build again before copying or downloading.

trials.limits: Actual browser UI interactions with GuideHollow's own local text formatter. The Copy success message was observed, but clipboard bytes were not independently inspected. Fictional garden facts were used; no AI model was called, no third-party products were evaluated, and no cross-browser compatibility claim is made.
